today_in_history_posts.title: Hiding entire content of on-chain transactions
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- A new Bitcoin design aims to fully hide transaction inputs and outputs.
- Only input and output hashes, plus a blinding factor for each output, are published.
- New private coins can be acquired by burning BTC, matched by denomination.

today_in_history_posts.title: Blinded channel observation
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- The Lightning Network risks accepting outdated, invalidated transaction states.
- Outsourcing vigilance enhances privacy through anonymization and blind processing.
- State data can be shared without trusting others due to advanced observer design.

today_in_history_posts.title: Deflationary money is a Good Thing
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Investment strategies differ as passive or active, each involving varying engagement levels.  - Passive investment issues include asset mismanagement and societal drawbacks, such as asset underutilization.  - The article explores stabilizing economies through a currency system backed by assets like Bitcoin.
